R49.definition: endoscopy score = max sample L-IMG; low if < t_low, high (flag) if > c_star, middle: the top-L-IMG sample is sequenced and the endoscopy is flagged if its L-LATE (their matrix) >= t_seq

R49_pkg.definition: as R49 with L-LATE from package-feature L-CNV (models_pkg); t_low and c_star identical; used where copy number comes from reads (ACE-B, 4x)

tier0_no_sequencing.definition: endoscopy score z = mean of the sample L-IMG logits (probabilities clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]; 1e-6 x top-sample logit tie-break); patient memory at endoscopy k = sum_{i<=k} w_i z_i / sum w_i, w_i = 0.5 ** ((t_k - t_i) / h); flag if memory >= threshold. No sequencing.

tier_confirmatory.definition: tier_light flags; at every flag the two top-L-IMG samples are sequenced (one already sequenced in the mean-logit gate's middle band) and the flag is cancelled if max ps_oac of the two < check bar (cn90: 90% of progressor endoscopies exceed it). ps_oac = sum over 17p 9p 18q 5q 4q 13q 3p of max(0, -arm deviation) + over 8q 7p 20q of max(0, arm deviation); arm deviation = arm copy number / the sample's median 5-Mb tile - 1 (per-sample package segmentation, ex_e2_veto.py tile_feats)

tier_light.definition: mean-logit gate: endoscopy score z = mean of the sample L-IMG logits (1e-6 x top-sample logit tie-break); low if sigmoid(z) < t_low, high if > c_star, middle: the top-L-IMG sample is sequenced; gate-aligned score g = z, or in the middle band logit(c_star) + logit(L-LATE of the sequenced top sample) - logit(t_seq); EW memory of g with half-life h; minus delta while certified (an earlier middle-band endoscopy <= Y years before whose sequenced top sample had logit L-CNV < quiet cut); flag if >= threshold. Sequences the mean-logit gate's middle-band top sample.

tier_confirmatory.definition: tier_light flags; at every flag the two top-L-IMG samples are sequenced (one already sequenced in the middle band) and the flag is cancelled if max ps_oac of the two < check bar (cn90: 90% of progressor endoscopies exceed it). ps_oac = sum over 17p 9p 18q 5q 4q 13q 3p of max(0, -arm deviation) + over 8q 7p 20q of max(0, arm deviation); arm deviation = arm copy number / the sample's median 5-Mb tile - 1 (per-sample package segmentation, ex_e2_veto.py tile_feats)

tier_light.definition: gate-aligned score g = logit(max L-IMG), or in the R49 middle band logit(c_star) + logit(L-LATE of the sequenced top sample) - logit(t_seq); EW memory of g with half-life h; minus delta while certified (an earlier middle-band endoscopy <= Y years before whose sequenced top sample had logit L-CNV < quiet cut); flag if >= threshold. Sequences the R49 middle band's top sample.

patient_aggregation.late: L-LATE sample probability = (L-CNV + L-IMG) / 2, then the same aggregation
patient_aggregation.paper1_patient_score: per model, sample probability -> logit (clip 1e-6) -> mean over the endoscopy's samples -> max over the patient's included endoscopies (equal to the endoscopy mean logit when a patient has one endoscopy)
patient_aggregation.sensitivity_aggregation: max over all the patient's sample probabilities

qc_spec.embedding: sample embedding = mean of the clean tiles' UNI2-h embeddings over all the sample's slides; fewer than min_tiles clean: top up to min_tiles with flagged tiles by highest tissue share, then highest lapvar_t, then bag order (code/tp_cln_pipeline.py)
qc_spec.flag: artefact = (tissue < tissue_min) OR (not glass AND line_d >= line_d_min) OR (ink > ink_max) OR (not glass AND lapvar_t < lapvar_t_min, missing counted as below)
qc_spec.lapvar_t_min_origin: 5th percentile of lapvar_t over non-glass tiles with a value, all set-C tiles (ART, docs/two_papers_ART.md); fixed here as a constant
qc_spec.pixel_statistics: tp_art_qc.py pixel_stats (code/tp_art_qc.py): tissue = share of pixels with HSV saturation > 0.15 and not white (all RGB > 220); line_d = max over rows and columns (3-line running mean) of the share of dark unstained pixels (s < 0.12, grey < 160); ink = share with hue 80-250 deg, s > 0.25, not white; lapvar_t = variance of the Laplacian of grey over tissue pixels (1-px border dropped), missing if < 500 tissue pixels
qc_spec.tile_geometry: UNI2-h tiles of the L-IMG bags: 224 px at level 2 (about 0.88 um/px), stored coordinates are tile CENTRES (top-left = centre - 112, clamped to the level; extract_foundation_from_masks.py); 256 tiles per slide

selection.caveat: chosen on fold-model (out-of-fold) predictions; applying them to the frozen models fitted on all of set C assumes similar score distributions on new data (tb_frozen.py caveat)
selection.freezing: per repeat; continuous values = median over the 10 repeats, discrete = mode (ties: first in candidate order); sequential: gate cut-offs -> hyper-parameters -> quiet cut -> thresholds; check bar = 90%-sensitivity bar of max ps_oac over the two top-H&E samples of progressor endoscopies
selection.population: 571 pre-event samples, 288 endoscopies, 75 patients (32 progressors) of the 676 samples from 80 patients with a matched H&E slide
selection.rule: rv9 operating rule: threshold = the D-th highest progressor-patient maximum score, D = progressor patients the R49 gate detects; candidate with the fewest non-progressor patients flagged among those detecting >= D
selection.training_predictions: outer out-of-fold predictions of the stored 10 x 10 patient-grouped CV (killcoyne_mm/cv/preds, cfg 00 / 01 / 02), one repeat at a time, in the role of inner out-of-fold predictions
